XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Loss of power, jerking and white smoke coming from the vehicle's exhaust
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | SMOKING | PERFORMANCE | SAW | SLOW | PERFORMANCE | P2200 | UNCERTAIN | JERKS | LOCK | EGR |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Anti-pollution

  • Device: EGR valve (exhaust gas recirculation).

  • Fault: The car suddenly lost power, began to jerk and emitted white smoke from the exhaust.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P2200 - NOx sensor bank 1

  • Cause: The EGR valve did not close completely due to deformation of the plate.

• Action: Proceed with replacement of EGR valve

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Although the error code indicated a problem with the NOx sensor, the real cause was a faulty EGR valve.
